status: seventh aggregation slice: resolution and order retention skip the rebuild when nothing moved, cutting resolve interning 88% on NovyWave with no diagnostics or plan drift

change.cut: no-op fast paths in resolve_term_inner and retain_requirement_order
change.what: resolution now tracks whether any child resolved to a different term; when none did, the composite term is already its own resolution and is returned without rebuilding or interning. Order retention does the same: the rebuilt field/variant sequence is compared against the current term, and when it already matches, the current term is returned instead of being re-interned. List, set, map, function and union arms reuse the term when their children are unchanged.
change.why: NovyWave's resolve phase issued about 237,000 intern requests and order retention about 2,600, all of them re-deriving terms that were already in the arena (the overall intern hit rate is 92%).
change.soundness: a container built from unchanged children is the identical structure, so the interned result would be the same term; the order receipt rebuild is compared element by element against the stored term before the short circuit. Nothing about resolution or receipt semantics changes.
